edition.note: Locked from Harvey OCR (archive sanctiirenaeiep00harvgoog); Massuet III.xviii.7 = Harvey CAP. XIX §7.

source_text: Quod autem parebat, hoc et erat; Deus, hominis antiquam plasmationem in se recapitulans, ut occideret quidem peccatum, evacuaret autem mortem, et vivificaret hominem: et propter hoc vera opera ejus.
pass_a_gloss: But what was appearing, this also was; God, recapitulating in himself the ancient formation of man, that he might kill indeed sin, and evacuate death, and vivify man: and on account of this his works are true.
pass_b_english: What he appeared to be, that he also was: God summing up in himself the ancient fashioning of humankind, so that he might destroy sin, empty death of its power, and give life to man — and for that reason his works are true.

choices.why: Keep the technical recapitulation verb; plasmationem as Adam’s fashioning, not generic ‘creation’.
evacuare = strip of force, not ‘evacuate’ as modern English.

anf_compare.notes: New English from locked Harvey Latin; not ANF as reading text.
